title: Greater Court Hymns
content_zh:
Great and illustrious is King Wen!
Oh, how glorious was his virtue.
Heaven protects and secures your throne —
Your reign shall know no end.
Grandly flows the Zhou dynasty.
The ruler makes no errors.
He serves as model to all the lands.
content_en:
Great and illustrious is King Wen!
Oh, how glorious was his virtue.
Heaven protects and secures your throne —
Your reign shall know no end.
Grandly flows the Zhou Dynasty.
The ruler makes no errors.
He serves as model to all the lands.
